neighbours.label: the continuation piece that completes a split proper name or institutional compound (Fujim|ori, Fon|agy, Dream|world, Micro|biology, Design| Systems), not a name that is a single token
fire: The rifle was designed by Mikhail Kalashnikov shortly after the war.
Her review appeared in the Annual Review of Neurobiology last autumn.
The sociologist Toshio Yamagishi studied trust in Japanese and American samples.
Fans still argue about whether Waterworld deserved its reputation.
The robot company in the film was called Cyberdyne Systems.
The course handbook lists Micropaleontology as an optional third-year unit.
He cited a long paper on Psychobiology from the nineteen seventies.
Delegates from Autodesk and Cadence Design Systems shared the panel.
quiet: The rifle was designed by a Soviet sergeant shortly after the war.
Her review appeared in the Annual Review of Medicine last autumn.
The sociologist Max Weber studied trust in Italian and American samples.
Fans still argue about whether the sequel deserved its reputation.
The robot company in the film was never given a name in the script.
The course handbook lists Physics as an optional third-year unit.
He cited a long paper on psychology from the nineteen seventies.
Delegates from Oracle and Microsoft shared the panel.

predictions: Fires on the second or later piece of a multi-piece name; the same sentence with a single-token name stays near zero.
short: tail piece of a split proper name
notes: Probe replicated the card: Fujim|ori 0.887, Fon|agy 0.783, Micro|biology 0.521, Design| Systems 0.492, Dream|world 0.416; the same sentences with one-token substitutes 0.007-0.034.
